cover.desc: Full color, restrained palette. A plain dark wooden door standing alone in an endless flat white field, painted with hard-edged shadow shapes, a small worn brass plate at eye height. The door is slightly ajar and warm amber light spills out of the gap across the white floor in one long clean wedge. Two small figures stand in that light with their backs to the viewer — a dark-haired boy and a pale-haired girl, shoulders almost touching, neither reaching for the handle. Bone white, ice blue, one amber wedge. Colored lineart, enormous negative space, the door small in a very large frame.
